description: This Java source file defines the PoliciesModelFactory class, a utility class providing static factory methods for creating policy-related objects such as Policy, PolicyEntry, Subject, Resource, and their associated components. It includes methods for constructing objects from JSON representations, with a focus on policy management within the Eclipse Ditto framework.

classes.name: PoliciesModelFactory
classes.description: A utility class providing static factory methods for creating policy-related objects such as Policy, PolicyEntry, Subject, Resource, and their components within the Eclipse Ditto framework.

methods.name: newLabel
methods.description: Creates a new Label object from a character sequence, or casts if already a Label.

methods.name: newSubjectIssuer
methods.description: Creates a new SubjectIssuer object from a character sequence.

methods.name: newSubjectId
methods.description: Creates a new SubjectId from issuer and subject sequences, or casts if already a SubjectId.

methods.name: newSubjectType
methods.description: Creates a new SubjectType from a character sequence.

methods.name: newSubject
methods.description: Creates a new Subject with a given SubjectId.

methods.name: newSubjects
methods.description: Creates a new Subjects collection from an iterable or JSON object.

methods.name: emptySubjects
methods.description: Creates an empty Subjects collection.

methods.name: newResourceKey
methods.description: Creates a ResourceKey from a character sequence or JsonPointer, validating format.

methods.name: splitTypeWithPath
methods.description: Splits a type with path string into type and path components.

methods.name: newResourceKey
methods.description: Creates a ResourceKey from resource type and path sequences.

methods.name: newResource
methods.description: Creates a Resource from resource key and permissions.

methods.name: emptyResources
methods.description: Creates an empty Resources collection.

methods.name: newResources
methods.description: Creates a Resources collection from iterable or JSON object.

methods.name: newEffectedPermissions
methods.description: Creates an EffectedPermissions object from granted and revoked permissions.

methods.name: newPolicyRevision
methods.description: Creates a PolicyRevision with a specified revision number.

methods.name: noPermissions
methods.description: Creates an empty Permissions object.

methods.name: newPermissions
methods.description: Creates Permissions from a collection or individual permissions.

methods.name: newPolicyEntry
methods.description: Creates a PolicyEntry from label, subjects, and resources.

methods.name: newPolicyEntries
methods.description: Creates multiple PolicyEntries from JSON object or string.

methods.name: newPolicyBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new PolicyBuilder instance.

methods.name: newPolicy
methods.description: Creates a new Policy from JSON object or string, or from parameters.
